description: Create a contact. 'first_name' and 'last_name' required. Optional: email, phone, position, department, salutation, academic_title, account_id (main organisation), notes, gender (m|w|d|x = no answer), birth_date (YYYY-MM-DD) or birth_year. More organisations: set_contact_accounts; more e-mails/phones/addresses: upsert_contact_point; labels: set_record_labels.

birth_year.description: When only the year is known

position.description: Job title or position of the contact

name: create_contact
